milestones.goal: One county (Panola) audited end to end from the command line: scan read, sums checked, failing cells re-read, public file audited, findings and corrected file written
The second layout, all eight counties unattended, and a measured before and after from one real failure found in the traces
The results page shows a finished run with a finding drawn on the scan
Evidence, security, cleanup, deploy, recording and submission

tasks.title: Scaffold, sources, rendering, ledger and checks
tasks.objective: A uv project whose deterministic core (downloads, page rendering, the SQLite ledger, the row, column and grid checks) works and is tested, with no model call
acceptance: WHEN `crossfoot filecheck --all` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL list every row of each published file whose votes differ from the sum of its parts
WHEN `crossfoot render --county panola --page 1` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL write a PNG of that page at 200 dpi
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: Model client, tracing, block finding and the first read of Panola
tasks.objective: Panola's six pages are read block by block into the ledger with a traced, budget-guarded model client, and the checks report which sums hold
acceptance: WHEN `crossfoot read --county panola` finishes THE SYSTEM SHALL print cells read, sums passing and sums failing, and write them to the run folder
IF the model's answer is not valid JSON or has the wrong number of columns THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL ask once for a repair and otherwise mark the block failed
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: Investigation loop, audit against the published file, and outputs
tasks.objective: `crossfoot audit --county panola` closes the county, audits the published file and writes findings, crops, a corrected file and a report
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: The report layout, the layout decision and the unattended run over all counties
tasks.objective: Counties in the one-precinct-per-page layout are read and audited, the layout is decided per county, and `crossfoot audit --all` runs unattended and resumes
acceptance: WHEN `crossfoot audit --county san_saba` finishes THE SYSTEM SHALL list the published file's row that fails its own total
IF a county's layout cannot be decided THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL report it as not supported and leave it alone
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: One real failure taken from its trace to a fix, with a run before and a run after
tasks.objective: The worst failure of the recorded run is found in the traces, fixed, and the same run repeated, with the numbers of both runs written down
acceptance: WHEN the fix is in THE SYSTEM SHALL have two run folders for the same counties, before and after, and a table of their numbers in docs/evidence/before-after.md
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: Site data and the audit view, golden path
tasks.objective: `crossfoot site build` writes the page's data from a real run and the page shows a finished run with a finding drawn on the scan
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: The audit view's states, replay, small screens, motion and accessibility
tasks.objective: Every state in UI-SPEC.md is reachable with ?state=, the replay works with a Pause, the page reflows at 320 and passes the checks
verify: observe: the first screen measured at 1440x900 and 390x844 with the action and a finding visible
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: Evidence page, security pass and cleanup
tasks.objective: The README's first screen says what this is and links every piece of evidence; no secret, placeholder or unused file is left
acceptance: WHEN a stranger opens the repository THE SYSTEM SHALL show what it does, the findings, and links to the traces, checkpoints, plan and results page in the README's first screen
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

tasks.title: Deploy the results page and check what is live
tasks.objective: The results page is public at a stable URL and opens signed out on a finished run
verify: observe: the deployed URL opens signed out on a finished run at both sizes
tasks.rollback: git revert the task's commit; no data migration

acceptance: the video is 180 seconds or less
verify: observe: the video plays signed out and is 180 seconds or less
